scenes.headline: How toks returns Hugging Face's exact ids, fast
scenes.sub: Certified shortcuts around a small assembly merge loop
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Bodkin! A new tokenizer promises Hugging Face's exact token ids, far faster. Here's how.

scenes.text: Most pieces never run BPE. A table built at load answers them, and every shortcut is computed by the real algorithm or proven safe.
scenes.mark: computed by the real algorithm or proven safe
scenes.say: The idea: most pieces never run byte pair encoding. A table answers them, and every shortcut is computed or proven safe.

scenes.title: Where a piece of text goes

steps.say: First the text is cut into pieces by a vector scanner, sixty four bytes at a time, with no regex engine.
Each piece probes a table built at load. Every answer in it came from running the real merges.
Only a miss runs the merge loop, written in assembly. That loop is now the slow part.

scenes.label: of Llama 3 English pieces are answered by one table probe
scenes.note: 8.5% run the merge loop, and take about half the time
scenes.say: On English, four pieces in five are one table probe. The misses take half the time.

scenes.title: Exact means the same merge order

left.title: Merged id first
left.say: Order matters. Use the merged token's id as the priority, and this piece ends wrong.

right.title: Lowest rank, leftmost
right.say: Hugging Face merges the lowest rank first, ties to the left. Only that order matches.

scenes.title: One minimum picks the next merge

parts.say: Each pair gets one number, with the rank in the high bits.

parts.note: ties go to the leftmost pair
parts.say: The position in the low bits breaks ties to the left. One minimum finds the next merge.

items.text: Table values run the real merges
items.say: Table entries are computed, never guessed from spelling.

items.text: Characters premerged when neighbours are safe
items.say: A Chinese character starts whole only when its neighbours are safe.

items.text: Text cut only at certified points
items.say: Parallel encoding cuts only where the split provably keeps the ids.
And a file it can't match exactly is refused at load.

scenes.title: Llama 3, English, one GB10 core
scenes.note: fresh text, 4 KiB calls; on replays Gigatoken wins about half
scenes.say: On fresh English it leads its whole table. On replays, Gigatoken wins about half.

scenes.text: Fast and exact together: skip the merges only where the reference algorithm, or a written proof, says the ids cannot change.

recap: A table built at load answers most pieces
scenes.say: To recap: a table answers most pieces, order decides the ids, and every shortcut is checked.
